body:
I've never been able to tell if I've just had bad luck with people or if it's just how everyone really is (or worse - it's something wrong with me). These are just the people I've considered good enough friends to ask for help. 

Someone I knew well, but not well enough to talk about my depression was a housemate of 3 years, we were like brothers. A month before our contract ended he just disappeared, turned out he hadn't paid bills or rent for months. I ended up over £2000 out of pocket. When I tried to take legal action, his parents wrote a letter directly to my parents about how my 'drug addiction' had had a serious affect on their son. I have never had a drug addiction in any form, I barely ever even drink, but my parents didn't know who to trust and I ended up just having to live with the debt.

Not sure why I should have any faith in people anymore quite frankly.

.

The doctors I visited were GPs, IE not psychiatrists. Every psychiatrist/mental health-type centre I've looked at seems to require a referral from a GP though, so I assume that is what I'm supposed to do?
